items.q: What sets cleaners apart from a cleaning company?
items.a: We don't send anyone. You pick a profile yourself, see who they are, and book directly. We handle payment, verification, and guarantees; the cleaner works independently.

items.q: How do I know the cleaner is trustworthy?
items.a: Every cleaner goes through ID verification, a KvK check if self-employed, and reference checks. Reviews only come from verified customers.
At booking, but we hold it in escrow until 24 hours after a successful clean. On no-show or complaint, we stop the transfer and investigate.
Report within 24 hours. We mediate, arrange a re-clean at our cost if needed, or issue a full refund.

items.q: Can I book recurring slots (weekly, bi-weekly)?
items.a: Yes. On your first booking you can flag it as recurring. The cleaner confirms the rhythm; on illness we arrange a substitute from your shortlist.
Currently only within the Amsterdam ring + Amstelveen, Diemen, Duivendrecht. We expand based on waitlist demand.

items.q: How do I become a cleaner on the platform?
items.a: Create a profile, complete verification and KvK linking, and start once approved. We coach on photos, copy and pricing.

items.q: How much do you take from my rate?
items.a: Service fee is 18% of the hourly rate — transparent and visible at booking. This covers verification, escrow, customer support, and transaction costs.
